_doc: Two articles are the same story when (1) their titles are near-identical, or (2) they share a strong entity (carrier, group, airport or a specific aircraft variant) AND at least min_shared_tokens distinctive title words, or (3) they share a carrier/group AND a specific aircraft variant, or (4) they share at least min_shared_signals distinctive signals (numbers, model designators, engine makers) from title AND description, including a number and a model or maker. Broad entities (an aircraft family such as '737 MAX', or just 'Boeing') are never enough on their own. Rules 3 and 4 also need compatible event types (equal, or one of them unclassified). Podcasts and roundups mention several stories at once and only ever join through near-identical titles.
